repo_notes.content: This is a microfrontend (MFE) platform framework. Documentation should be structured around: the MFE scenario/landscape, what fe is and what it solves, what an MFE platform consists of, what fe owns, future roadmap, how-to guides, and advanced contributor topics. Prioritize the CLI, JIT bundler, runtime/shell, CI/CD workflows, and config/infra/CSP areas.
repo_notes.author: fe-platform maintainer

overview.purpose: A friendly, concise welcome page for the fe microfrontend platform. Must include: 1) A Markmap mind-map diagram (using ```markmap code block) showing an example MFE website with color-coded groupings, boundaries, and labels depicting: multiple teams (e.g. Team Checkout, Team Search, Team Profile), each owning different MFEs (e.g. checkout-widget, search-bar, profile-card), hosted in separate repos, composed into a single website shell. Use color and grouping to distinguish team boundaries, shared services, and the runtime shell. 2) Below the diagram, render a set of clickable navigation tiles/cards for different audiences and knowledge paths: Philosophy, Architectural Style, Technology Radar/Toolkit, APIs & Packages, Getting Started as a Platform, Getting Started as an MFE Team, Getting Started for a POC. Each tile should link to the corresponding wiki page. Keep the tone welcoming and concise — this is the front door.
